Satluj removal from OTT sparks debate on free speech and historical context

The removal of the film 'Kuttey' from the OTT platform Zee5 has triggered a debate, with some linking it to the film's portrayal of the Satluj river and its historical significance. A lawyer associated with Jaswant Singh Khalra has stated there is no pro-Khalistan sentiment in the film, while comedian Kunal Kamra has questioned the CBFC regarding the removal. The incident has raised questions about censorship and artistic expression.
